searchText: Is this the right place to talk about `eth2.0-deposit-cli`? I wanted to sync about a PR <@598717165163642891> sure, what is your question? added more metrics to the pool section, this should give us more transparency added (not pushed to public yet) *slashed validator amount *market share left: income per deposited ETH In the state column the numbers are respectively active, slashed and total after the "/"? Does total include pending validators? yes no it does not So why they don't add up like in Stkr? So offline validators are not included in "active"? yep, <https://beaconcha.in/pools> click on the "state" it will show you all inactive did it this way so we can figure out which pools have issues in case the participation rate drops will change to `active/total slashed` <@!755590043632140352> pending is included now https://i.imgur.com/D5GwDKC.png added income per deposited eth (I/D ETH) the difference is real kraken at 0.017 income per deposited ETH while stakefish is twice as much <@!755590043632140352> i think your like numbers ^ 😄 Ah wait this is accumulated? This may confuse users If it is > take all eth deposited and the income of the pool, then divide the total income by total deposit to revel profit per one eth Cause Kraken may have deposited a lot of validators not long ago, you may want to normalize by number of epochs active Otherwise this is very misleading that is true! IMHO divide by deposit is a very bad metric, because it has a bias towards older validators, even if they perform worse Nice stats page otherwise though, great work will see if we can add this was about to push it 😅 https://i.imgur.com/J2wjiYo.png looks like this if a pool has many inactive validators <@!97774605351010304> another thing you could add to that page that would be useful is the average or total validator stats, considered as a pool. This would give a proxy to solo staker vs pool performance I am trying to find metrics that indicate that solo stakers peform better than large staking pools so we can default sort the table by that. Could you give me more details? I wouldn't be sure that solo stakers perform better than pools. Anyway, what I meant about a Total row would be in the same order as your columns there: Total -- All --- N/A --- 100% --- Total Eth deposited in the contract --- total eth rewarded so far --- income divided by number of attestations (supposing you already implemented this for pools instead of dividing by ether) ---- total active validators ---- total slashed validators / total validators --- Avg att. Eff. -- Streak (this last one is likely to be 0 constantly) i see.. kk <@!203220829473996800> I opened a few PRs some weeks ago: https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-deposit-cli/pull/184 https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-deposit-cli/pull/183 Wanted to check if there's anything I can do to get some traction there I was actually looking for this! Thanks
